question: Sangeet Natak Akademi award winner, Tapan Kumar Pattanayak is a _________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhau**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Tapan Kumar Pattanayak** is a renowned Chhau dancer who has been recognized for his significant contributions to this traditional dance form.
 
• The **Chhau dance** is a semi-classical Indian dance with martial, tribal, and folk origins, originating from the eastern states of Odisha, Jharkhand, and West Bengal.
 
• Chhau dance integrates elements of folk and tribal traditions, and it is known for its vigorous and expressive movements, often depicting mythological stories and folklore.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is one of the most prestigious awards in India for performing arts, and winning this award highlights Tapan Kumar Pattanayak's mastery and dedication to Chhau dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi**

 
 
• Odissi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• It is characterized by its intricate footwork, fluid movements, and expressive gestures.
 
• Odissi dance is traditionally performed as a form of worship in temples and is known for its devotion and grace.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniattam**
 
 
• Mohiniattam is a classical dance form from Kerala, known for its graceful, swaying movements and feminine style.
 
• It is traditionally performed solo by women and depicts themes of love and devotion.
 
• The dance form emphasizes the Lasya aspect, which is the feminine and graceful movements.
 
 
 
• **Manipuri**
 
 
• Manipuri dance originates from the northeastern state of Manipur and is known for its lyrical and graceful movements.
 
• It often depicts themes from the life of Lord Krishna and Radha, focusing on devotion and spirituality.
 
• Manipuri dance is characterized by its elegant hand gestures, gentle footwork, and flowing costumes.
